# Synthetic Vendor DPA Excerpt

This synthetic excerpt is for `/privacy-legal:kr-pipa-dpa-review` testing only.
It contains no client facts.

## Processing

Vendor may process customer personal information to provide the service,
improve service quality, run analytics, and develop or improve AI models.
Customer authorizes Vendor to use usage data and submitted content for AI
training. This AI training permission applies unless Customer opts out in
writing.

## Subprocessors

Vendor may appoint any subprocessor, affiliate, cloud provider, contractor, or
service partner without prior notice to Customer. Vendor will remain generally
responsible for subprocessors.

## Cross-Border Transfer / 국외 이전

Customer acknowledges that personal information may be transferred, accessed,
stored, and processed outside Korea, including in the United States and other
locations where Vendor or its subprocessors operate. The specific recipient,
country, items, purpose, retention period, and safeguards may be updated on
Vendor's website from time to time.

## Security

Vendor will maintain commercially reasonable technical and organizational
security measures.

## Breach Notification / breach notification

Vendor will notify Customer of a confirmed security breach without undue delay
after Vendor completes its internal investigation.

## Return And Deletion

Vendor may retain backup copies for business continuity and legal compliance.
Deletion certification is not provided.
